title: Personal Checking: certificate principal in the same-day maintenance fee waiver review
content:
## Scope

This rule applies when the Relationship Balance waiver is judged for a Personal Checking monthly maintenance fee posted on the current business day, the cycle closing date. It states what the owner's PCB certificates of deposit add to the Relationship Balance for that judgement.

## Formal clause

For this determination, the certificate contribution is the principal balance of the owner's certificate in each of the statuses applied, active and grace period. The owner's certificate principal in these counted statuses is a part of the Relationship Balance compared with the tier's waiver level.

## Status table

| Status of the owner's certificate | Principal balance counted? |
|---|---|
| Applied | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| Grace period | Yes |
| Any other status | No |

## Worked cases (hypothetical owners)

- An owner holds one active certificate with a principal balance of 10000.00 USD. The certificate contribution is 10000.00 USD.
- An owner's certificate is in grace period status with a principal balance of 7500.00 USD. Grace period is a counted status, so 7500.00 USD is counted.
- An owner's only certificate is closed. It is in none of the counted statuses, so the certificate contribution is zero.

## Points of judgement

- **Wrong reading:** "interest the certificate has earned is added on top of the principal". **Correct basis:** the figure counted is the certificate's principal balance.
- **Wrong reading:** "a certificate in its grace period no longer counts". **Correct basis:** grace period is one of the counted statuses.
